name: Tokyo Debunker
source:
Solve supernatural cases in Tokyo alongside devilishly handsome ghouls and quirky cat familiars!

At the prestigious Darkwick Academy, your unruly classmates have sold their souls to demons in exchange for a wish… and you’ll have to find a way to make them work together to solve supernatural cases all over Tokyo. If you get stuck, you can always turn to Darkwick’s clever cat familiars for their support!

[Taken from App Store desc]
